title: Fmoc-Phe : Fmoc-Leu supramolecular hydrogels with adaptive antibacterial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13801-13811
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08809G, Paper

Romain Chevigny, Henna Rahkola, Efstratios D. Sitsanidis, Tatu Kumpulainen, Lisa J. White, Lotta-Riina Sundberg, Jennifer R. Hiscock, Mika Pettersson, Maija Nissinen
Dual-component Fmoc-Phe- and Fmoc-Leu-based hydrogels exhibit tunable mechanical properties and thermoresponsiveness. The antibacterial activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens can be tuned by varying the building-block ratio.
